suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as complication outcome risk. Require Buerger disease/thromboangiitis obliterans and a documented amputation outcome, preserving tobacco exposure, ischemic severity, and treatment history. Treatment/outcome systematic review supports amputation risk only; do not generalize this source to generic loss of use. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Thromboangiitis Obliterans (Buerger's Disease) and Amputation / Loss of Use of Limbs or Digits
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
